title: H6 on the current guest: round 31's students on net1 v7, net1 plus raw and raw alone, on the validation links
description: Run 294 (exp-net2-r31-blackbox-294) trained round 29's DAgger recipe with a student that learns u directly, three seeds per arm, on net1 v7's means (r31-net1), on them plus the raw measurements (r31-net1raw), and on the raw measurements alone with hidden size 64 and 256 (r31-raw64, r31-raw256). Each arm's policy as evaluated at iteration 59 (iter059/policy-updated.onnx, the end of the equal budget, chosen before the results) runs unchanged on the validation links at campaign seed 21 (the five families) and among 2 and 4 copies, beside the fixed rule at u = 0.25 on net1 v7 (rule-v7) and round 29's gate3 students on net1 v7 (net2-v7-sN, model-truth-patch-src). Criteria, stated in run 294 before the results, on the five-family mean over three seeds: H6 holds on the current guest if r31-net1 is no more than 0.02 below the better of r31-raw64 and r31-raw256; the LCFs leave out something net2 can use (against H1) if r31-net1raw beats r31-net1 by more than 0.02. Nothing is chosen.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); mkdir -p "$OUT/p"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule-v7" "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-v7=$OUT/rule-v7/rule-u0.25.onnx"); for s in 1 2 3; do d="$OUT/runs/r29-s$s"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5; P+=(--policy "net2-v7-s$s=$OUT/p/net2-v7-s$s.onnx"); for a in net1 net1raw raw64 raw256; do cp "$IN/r/ppo-r31-$a-s$s/iter059/policy-updated.onnx" "$OUT/p/r31-$a-s$s.onnx"; P+=(--policy "r31-$a-s$s=$OUT/p/r31-$a-s$s.onnx"); done; done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 32 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
